quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Metal Mining semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 2025 (IFRS, semi-annual report): net sales JPY 783,361 million (down 2.1%), profit before tax JPY 77,815 million (+6.6%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 53,940 million (+16.0%); the stronger yen offset higher copper and gold prices, and profit rose on Hishikari, the start-up of the Cote gold mine (Canada) and better equity-method results mainly from overseas copper mines. Segments: Resources net sales JPY 124,247 million (+36.1%), segment profit JPY 63,143 million (+44.6%); Smelting & Refining net sales JPY 603,400 million (down 3.9%), segment profit JPY 4,024 million (down 85.4%) on inventory valuation losses from currency moves, worse copper concentrate purchase terms and lower nickel prices; Materials net sales JPY 135,573 million (down 10.4%), segment profit JPY 6,697 million (+359.0%). Average prices: copper US$9,655/t, nickel US$6.85/lb, gold US$3,367.2/toz; JPY 146.04/US$. H1 R&D expense JPY 4,410 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 net sales JPY 783,361 million (down 2.1%); Materials segment profit JPY 6,697 million (+359.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Metal Mining semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Materials business, first half to September 2025 (management's analysis, semi-annual report): the company saw no drop in demand for its battery materials, and battery-materials profit rose on higher sales backed by pull-forward EV demand in the US; for electronic-component materials there was some inventory adjustment, but data-center infrastructure investment demand stayed strong and demand for its communication-device materials was generally firm; some products for China were affected by market conditions, but materials for communication devices and others earned more.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Metal Mining semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-12-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Production, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report; includes toll processing): electrolytic copper 214,970 t (221,593 t a year earlier), gold 6,945 kg (9,767 kg), electrolytic nickel 32,986 t (31,086 t), ferronickel 2,921 t (1,679 t). Mines: Hishikari gold sales 1.8 t, on plan toward 3.5 t a year; Morenci 153 kt and Cerro Verde 193 kt (both down on feed-grade changes), Quebrada Blanca 92 kt (flat), Cote gold mine 5.3 t; Coral Bay Nickel and Taganito HPAL Nickel output rose year on year.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 electrolytic nickel 32,986 t; electrolytic copper 214,970 t
